data.title: 妮姆芙 · 晨曦微风中的臂弯依恋
data.description: 晨光洒满洁白被褥，整夜缱绻后的妮姆芙小巧的身躯蜷缩在你的臂弯深处。透明羽翼像小被子一样轻轻盖在你的腰间，少女嘴角挂着毫无防备的极甜睡颜，在晨曦中发出舒服的呢喃。
data.location: bright peaceful morning bedroom filled with sunshine
data.action: curled up in white morning duvet, small face buried happily in partner crook of arm, wings wrapped softly around his waist like a cocoon in morning warmth
data.lighting: radiant golden morning sunbeams pouring across white bedspread
data.mood: ultimate sweet security, eternal lover devotion, peaceful morning newlywed bliss
data.promptProse: Curled in morning bed with wings wrapped around partner waist, Nymph nuzzles happily in his arm with flushed cheeks and an angelic sweet smile.
data.animaCaption: Nymph curled peacefully in partner arm in sunlit morning bed.
